title: Choose where delivery becomes complete
description: Inject a consumer failure, choose the acknowledgment contract, and set a delivery budget. The lab separates broker delivery from the business side effect.

scenarios.label: Healthy handler
scenarios.detail: The handler completes the business effect and can acknowledge normally.

scenarios.label: Crash before side effect
scenarios.detail: The consumer receives the message but exits before changing business state.

scenarios.label: Crash after side effect
scenarios.detail: Business state changes, but the connection closes before RabbitMQ receives the acknowledgment.

scenarios.label: Permanent validation failure
scenarios.detail: Every delivery fails because the payload violates the consumer contract.

ackModes.label: Acknowledge before work
ackModes.detail: Removes the message from broker responsibility before the business effect is known.

ackModes.label: Acknowledge after work
ackModes.detail: Redelivers unacknowledged work, but the side effect can repeat after an ambiguous crash.

ackModes.label: Deduplicate, then acknowledge
ackModes.detail: Records a stable message ID with the business effect so redelivery cannot repeat it.
